context_requirements: Functional NR5A1 expression and an active NR5A1-dependent transcriptional program
Cell lineage with steroidogenic capacity (adrenal, gonadal, or placental) or NR5A1-dependent cancer
None of the nine profiled lines are known to require NR5A1 for survival or gene expression
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in NR5A1 target genes (e.g., CYP11A1, STAR, CYP17A1) in any of the nine lines
Consistent transcriptional signature shared across multiple lines at 6 h or 24 h
Growth inhibition or apoptosis in a line that lacks NR5A1 expression
